_purpose: SECB-WP-FWK-090. The durable home for reusable patterns established across FWK-079..089, which until now existed only in pull-request comments -- ungreppable by the next agent and unverifiable by any tool. Each entry declares HOW it is guarded, and scripts/check_pattern_ledger.py refuses any entry whose declared guard disagrees with this tree. See docs/00-governance/REUSABLE_PATTERN_LEDGER.md for the contract. PENDING_MERGE requires DUAL-TREE binding: the cited guard must be absent from this tree AND readable at a pinned pending_head. Entries whose pending head is not fetchable where the gate runs are PROSE_ONLY with the head recorded in the note -- an unverifiable claim is not a weaker claim.

patterns.name: Claim strength never exceeds mechanism strength
patterns.note: The root pattern. Every entry below is a special case of it: a document may not claim more than its mechanism does, and a mechanism may not claim more than has been observed.

patterns.name: Individual mergeability is not ordered-prefix integrability
Measure with the merge method the repository will actually use
Compare-and-swap execution on a pinned head
Evidence never confers authority
A policy verdict requires a valid observation
One terminal reason, competitors absent not merely unmentioned
Observation watermark ordering
Dual-subject evidence binding
Tool drift is cohort drift
patterns.rule: SAME_INPUTS != SAME_COHORT when the measuring toolchain differs

patterns.name: The observer must not perturb the observed
Control membership is derived from the execution graph, not declared
Bootstrap fix without self-registration
patterns.note: Four applications: #153, its correction, #144 (registration PRESERVED for a different reason -- see RP-014), #146 (dropped).

patterns.name: Semantic role before registration removal
patterns.note: Classify before deleting: MEMBERSHIP_ASSERTION | PORTABILITY_ASSERTION | NEGATIVE_PORTABILITY_RATIONALE | MIGRATION_TOMBSTONE. Only the first becomes unnecessary when graph membership is false. A missing detector is why the record is load-bearing, not permission to drop it.

patterns.name: Phase-complete structural elimination
patterns.rule: DESIGN_AVAILABLE ^ DATA_MIGRATED ^ LEGACY_WRITERS_DRAINED ^ CONSUMERS_CUT_OVER ^ SINGLE_AUTHORITY_CONFIRMED ^ TRANSITION_OBSERVED -> CONTENTION_STRUCTURALLY_ELIMINATED
patterns.note: No earlier conjunct substitutes for a later one. SHARDING_DESIGN_LANDED != CONTENTION_ELIMINATED: #153 landed schema, aggregator, canonical digest and verifier while authority stayed with the monolith.

patterns.name: Typed multi-path readback
patterns.note: A successful alternative call is insufficient; it must independently establish the same commit, tree, current ref and merge shape. Paid for itself three times in one session: a 403 on a commit readback, a 503 on an artifact download, a 503 on a comment POST.

patterns.name: Actuator admission before autonomous execution
patterns.note: Record measurement: NOT_STARTED rather than inferring a result the missing actuator could not produce. Corollary observed live: a transient failure of one actuator path (git fetch, an API endpoint) is not loss of the actuator -- probe a second path before declaring it unavailable.

patterns.name: A sandbox may never observe production
A role label is not a platform principal
A producer may not certify its own evidence
Cryptographic coverage closure
patterns.rule: asserted_fact ^ exact_signed_field ^ authorized_key_role ^ signer_identity == asserted_producer ^ signed_authority_over_the_decision ^ freshness -> AUTHENTICATED; any missing edge -> COVERAGE_GAP
patterns.note: Guard not claimed here. It exists at PR #159 head f84514ea8491d7ca98b982b195e155ff9174b199 (f84514ea8491), but a PENDING_MERGE claim requires the pinned head to be READABLE where the gate runs, and a pull request's branch objects are not fetched by the checkout that validates this ledger. Claiming PENDING_MERGE without that read would prove only TEST_ABSENT_HERE ^ PR_NUMBER_NAMED, which is the defect this field was corrected for. Promote to MECHANICAL when the PR lands. patterns.name: Counterexample-first verification
patterns.rule: GUARD_PRESENT != GUARD_LOAD_BEARING -> write the document the guard must refuse BEFORE the guard
patterns.note: Three review rounds on #159 each found a check that existed without a counterexample proving it load-bearing. Two hand-run mutations (whole-block compare -> suffix scan; jti guard removed) were the only mechanical proof, and each broke exactly one test. This ledger's own anti-phantom rule is the first instance guarded by construction.

patterns.name: A cited guard must exist in the tree that cites it
patterns.note: Checked in both directions: a phantom MECHANICAL citation is refused, and so is a stale PENDING_MERGE whose tests have all landed. Under-claiming decays the ledger as surely as over-claiming.

patterns.name: Historical evidence is superseded, not invalidated
patterns.note: Also INTEGRATION_PASS != POLICY_PASS: a security refusal does not retract the integration fact beside it. #159 revisions 1 and 2 keep valid integration artifacts.

patterns.name: Checks bind a head, not a base
patterns.note: GitHub does not re-run a PR's checks when its base moves. The gap is closed by an integration measurement against the current base, never inherited from the rollup.

patterns.name: A read is not the state
patterns.note: Observed three times in one round: a PATCH response returned a superseded head after the push landed; a readback job printed its verdict while the jobs API still reported in_progress; two runs shared an identical created_at so neither could be ordered first. Re-read from a second path before reporting.

patterns.name: Empty input is not an empty measurement
patterns.note: check_budget.py prints a PASS at 0/N when stdin is empty; a zero-byte receipt has a perfectly valid SHA-256. Both launder absence into evidence. Filed, not yet fixed.
